human_action.surveyor_request: Verify the system-scoped root-capture reset with Surveyor 0.3.67 and Runtime-A 1.0.6.
steps: In Surveyor's GitHub / updates section, click Check app update, then Install update when v0.3.67 is offered. In the same section, click Check lane extensions and confirm Runtime-A is 1.0.6.
Keep WinDbg closed. In Surveyor's Game section, click Start NMS and wait for the probe to show Connected.
Use the in-game star map to warp into a different system. In Surveyor's Overlay details, watch the Root resource row and confirm the old system's capture clears.
Wait only until the first root event from the new system is captured, then stop; no full traversal is required. Close NMS normally.
In Surveyor's Runtime-A 1.0.6 panel, click Upload captured root event and wait for the upload success receipt.
human_action.success_condition: After the system address changes, the prior Root resource capture clears; the next root event is associated with the new system and its JSON contains raw seed, UseSeedValue, and effective seed/state. Surveyor shows upload success.
evidence_to_return: The Surveyor upload receipt/run-manifest path and the uploaded root-event JSON, or a screenshot of the Root resource row clearing plus the upload success receipt.
